svg.title: CXV-9 Meridian Crew Vehicle — Detail & Data Sheet (GA-0102, Sheet 2/2)
svg.desc: Transverse section B-B, RE-60 engine detail, docking port detail, RCS layout, mass properties, propellant budget, legend, ICD and revision history.
svg.text: CXV-9 'MERIDIAN' — DETAIL & DATA SHEET: SECTION B–B, ENGINE, DOCKING, RCS, MASS
SHEET 2 OF 2 — DWG GA-0102 — REF GA-0101 (GENERAL ARRANGEMENT) — DIMENSIONS IN METERS — PRINCIPAL SCALE 1:50, DETAILS AS NOTED

g.text: CUT PLANE PERPENDICULAR TO FLIGHT AXIS — LOOKING AFT

g.text: TUNNEL Ø 0.48 m — CREW TRANSFER — MASS 85 kg

g.title: RE-60 main engine cutaway, scale 1:25 — regen + film cooled bell, gimballed turbopump
g.text: RE-60: 60 kN VAC — Isp 462 s — ṁ 13.2 kg/s — Pc 8.5 MPa — MASS 210 kg — THROTTLE 60–109%
BELL LENGTH 1.55 m — RESTARTABLE ×20 — SINGLE-SHAFT LOX/FUEL PUMP

g.title: RCS thruster layout, 16 x 50 N in four quads, cross-strapped
g.text: RCS ΔV BUDGET 120 kg — PULSE 20 ms MIN

g.title: Mass properties and propellant budget tables
g.text: CG REFERENCED TO NOSE TIP (STA 0.00). TANK CG SHIFTS ±0.15 m DURING BURN.
MARGINS: 3% STRUCTURE, 5% DRY MASS, 2.5σ DISPERSION PER ECSS-E-ST-32C.

g.title: Legend of line types, symbols and graphic scale
g.text: LINEWEIGHTS PER ASME Y14.2; ARROW SIZE PER Y14.5.

g.title: Revision history A through C

g.text: ECLSS 78% LOOP; RCS 16-CH; ICD + MASS SHEET
REVISIONS INCORPORATED ON BOTH SHEETS GA-0101 / GA-0102. ECN-0147.

g.title: Docking and umbilical interface control summary

g.text: DOCKING: IDSS-C RING Ø 0.80 m — 12 LATCHES — CAPTURE 5 kN
POWER UMBILICAL: 28 VDC — 6 kW MAX — REDUNDANT BUS A/B
DATA: MIL-STD-1553B + 1 GbE — CCSDS TM/TC VIA S/Ka HGA
GUIDANCE: 3 PETALS — RING TRAVEL ±80 mm — SOFT CAPTURE
PROP TRANSFER: NONE — SINGLE-LOAD NTO/MMH BEFORE LAUNCH
MASS AT DOCK: ≤ 12,050 kg — AXIAL APPROACH 0.05–0.3 m/s
MERIDIAN AEROSPACE CORP. — SPACE SYSTEMS DIV.
